display.purpose: Hero h1 and major section h2. Cormorant Garamond carries the brand voice; tight leading and compressed letter-spacing give magazine-grade weight.

headline.purpose: Page hero h1, mid-level section heads, large card titles.

title.purpose: Service card titles, process-step headings, panel inner titles.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, set in Smoke Walnut Soft. Max line length 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, panel titles, footer kickers. Always preceded by the 2.8rem brass hairline.

shadows.name: soft-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default lift for raised surfaces — service cards at rest, mobile nav social buttons, feature cards.

shadows.name: strong-ambient
shadows.purpose: Deeper variant on hover and on the most prominent panels (CTA panels, hero overlays).

shadows.name: brass-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the primary CTA only. Brass-tinted glow signaling the single committable action on the screen.

motion.name: ease-premium
motion.purpose: Default easing across hover, reveal, and shimmer transitions. Ease-out-quart character.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and small-state transitions on buttons, nav, and cards.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Site-load reveal on header, social rail, hero, and page hero.

motion.name: duration-shimmer
motion.purpose: Primary-button diagonal sheen sweep on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brass-gradient CTA with controlled diagonal sheen on hover. The single committable action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d99a2b, #ffb73a 62%, #ffd27c); color: #fffdf9; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.28); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -40% auto -40% -30%; width: 46%; transform: translateX(-145%) skewX(-22deg); background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.42), transparent); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: transform 680ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 22px 42px rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.36); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(290%) skewX(-22deg); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.55); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Soft Linen surface, eucalyptus hairline border. The supporting action that does not compete with primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(111, 169, 154, 0.24); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(251, 247, 241, 0.8); color: #221d18; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55), 0 10px 24px rgba(93, 63, 28, 0.06); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(255, 253, 248, 0.96); border-color: rgba(111, 169, 154, 0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.55); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Section-opening micro-label preceded by the signature brass hairline. The system's connective tissue.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; color: #d99a2b; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.22em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 2.8rem; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.82), rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.18)); }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Photo-led card on Soft Linen surface. On hover the photograph scales while the frame stays anchored.
components.html:
Čišćenje stanova

Redovno i detaljno čišćenje doma

Za stanove i kuće kojima je potreban uredan, osvežen i reprezentativan izgled bez opterećenja za vlasnike.
components.css: .ds-service-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fbf7f1; border-radius: 32px; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(93, 63, 28, 0.12); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(34, 29, 24, 0.17); } .ds-service-card-media { aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; } .ds-service-card-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-card-media img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-service-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-card-tag { display: inline-block; color: #d99a2b; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.22em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.6rem 0; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.65rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #221d18; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 0; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.99rem; line-height: 1.66; color: #5f4c3a; }

components.name: Inquiry Input
components.description: Bright Linen field on dark CTA panel. Brass focus ring — the global one used everywhere.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 245, 224, 0.74); } .ds-input { height: 52px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.32); border-radius: 12px; background: #fffdf8; color: #221d18; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a735c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.55); outline-offset: 3px; border-color: rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.55); }

components.name: Site Navigation Link
components.description: Header link with a left-anchored 1px underline that strokes in on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.35rem 0; color: #5f4c3a; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #221d18; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -0.2rem; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.55); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: CTA Panel
components.description: The single dark surface in the page body — Charred Oak band that signals 'this is where you act.'
components.html:
Kontakt

Ako želite ozbiljnu uslugu, dogovor počinje jednostavno.

Pošaljite upit ili nas pozovite. Dobićete jasan predlog usluge i termin koji ima smisla za vaš prostor.
components.css: .ds-cta-panel { padding: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 4rem); background: #2a2724; border-radius: 32px; color: #fffdf8; box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(34, 29, 24, 0.17); } .ds-cta-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; color: #d99a2b; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.22em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 1.22rem; } .ds-cta-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 2.8rem; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.82), rgba(217, 154, 43, 0.18)); } .ds-cta-heading { margin: 0 0 1rem 0; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.2vw, 3.2rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 0.96; letter-spacing: -0.028em; color: #fffdf8; } .ds-cta-copy { margin: 0; max-width: 44rem; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.04rem; line-height: 1.72; color: rgba(255, 253, 248, 0.78); }

narrative.overview: MS Sjaj is the cleaning service that does not perform. Pages do not announce themselves. CTAs do not shout. Hero typography is set in Cormorant Garamond — a magazine-grade serif that carries the weight while everything around it stays quiet. The page background is Warm Linen, not white; the ink is Smoke Walnut, not black. Every surface is tinted toward the brass accent so the system feels like one warm room rather than a stack of unrelated tiles. The operative metaphor is delivery, not décor. Buyers are real-estate agents preparing units for showings, project managers handing over post-construction sites, and homeowners who want it done and signed off. The interface is built to convince them that the operator running this site will arrive on time, work without disturbance, and leave the space ready for inspection.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial pairing — Cormorant Garamond display set against Manrope body, carrying a magazine cadence into a service-business surface.
Warm Linen room, not a white page. Backgrounds are tinted; 'white' is reserved for very few raised surfaces.
Old Brass is the single accent. It earns ≤10% of any screen.
Hairline gradient dividers and gentle ambient lift do most of the depth work; cards do not float.
Photography-led proof. Real before/after evidence does the selling, not bullet lists.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Old Brass is used on ≤10% of any given screen. It is never a fill, never gradient text, never a side-stripe accent. If a screen feels brass-heavy, remove a use, do not add another.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Every screen lives within Linen + Walnut by default. Eucalyptus appears only in hairlines and tints. There is never a third family.

rules.name: The No-White-Page Rule
rules.body: Warm Linen is the page; Bright Linen is the rare raised surface. #ffffff is forbidden as a background. So is #000000 as ink.

rules.name: The Two-Voices-Only Rule
rules.body: Cormorant for headings, Manrope for everything else. No third typeface, no script, no variable-font display experiments.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every label is preceded by a 2.8rem-wide gradient hairline that taper-fades from rgba(217,154,43,0.82) to rgba(217,154,43,0.18). The hairline is the visual rhyme that holds the system together.

rules.name: The 12.5px Floor
rules.body: Body-adjacent labels never go below 0.78rem (~12.5px). Anything smaller is decorative-only.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Section seams are marked with a 1px tapered gradient strip, not with hard borders or contrasting backgrounds. Hairlines do depth before shadows do.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is brown- or brass-tinted. rgba(0,0,0,X) shadows are forbidden — they read as cool and clinical, the wrong room.

dos: Do lead with photography — every page should carry at least one full-bleed or generously framed real interior. The room is the proof.
Do preserve the eyebrow hairline above every label. The 2.8rem brass taper is the system's connective tissue.
Do use Old Brass on ≤10% of any screen. Count it before you ship.
Do keep Cormorant Garamond as the only serif and Manrope as the only sans. Two voices, no exceptions.
Do use the global brass focus ring (2px / 55% / 3px offset) on every focusable element. One ring, everywhere.
Do put new CSS in mobile-first scopes. Add desktop overrides via min-width queries, not the other way around.
Do ship reduced-motion fallbacks for any new entrance animation.
Do name colors descriptively in code comments and CSS variables (Old Brass / Warm Linen). The names carry the brand.
donts: Don't use stock-photo cleaning imagery, green checkmark badges, '100% satisfaction' tags, or 'brzo i jeftino' discount language.
Don't ship Bootstrap-card SaaS landings: identical 3- or 4-up icon+heading+text grids repeated down the page.
Don't ship the hero-metric template — big number, small label, supporting stats with gradient accents.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe) on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't apply gradient text via background-clip: text. Solid Smoke Walnut for headings.
Don't add decorative glassmorphism. The header gets a Bright Linen wash on scroll — that is the only blurred surface on the site.
Don't use #ffffff as a background or #000000 as ink. Warm Linen and Smoke Walnut. Always.
Don't use cool gray (rgba(0,0,0,X)) drop shadows. Every shadow is brown- or brass-tinted.
Don't claim form success before the email actually leaves. The status line speaks in operational facts, never premature confirmations.
Don't introduce a third color family or a third typeface. The two-family rule holds.
Don't convert the comparison slider to a library or framework component. The CSS-variable + clip-path implementation is part of the brand's restraint.
Don't use exclamation marks, 'najbolji,' '100% guaranteed,' or any superlative. Concrete operational facts only.
